<thought>Based on the spectrum, a strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak (211 → 213 Da) matches the characteristic chlorine isotopic pattern (Cl‑35/Cl‑37 ≈ 3:1). The noticeable M+1 peak (~12 % of the base) aligns with the expected 13C contribution for a molecule containing roughly 10–12 carbons. These patterns allow us to definitively identify carbon and chlorine in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
